title: Gemini Enterprise web chat: immediate 8-second hero spot via transfer_to_agent
runtime: Path A fixture rt-gemini-enterprise-webchat (transfer_to_agent present, no shell)
prompt: Make me a short vertical ad video for this brand. Brand: NordicGlow Skincare. Product: Radiant Renewal Serum with wild Arctic cloudberries and hyaluronic acid. Audience: adults 25-45 who want a simple winter skincare routine. Key claim: +84% hydration in 24 hours (dermatologically tested). Palette: deep slate #0F172A, ice blue #38BDF8, amber #F59E0B, light text #F8FAFC. Tone: calm, premium, Scandinavian. CTA: Discover More at nordicglow.example.
expected_behaviour: On turn 1 the agent calls transfer_to_agent(agent_name='videogen_agent') with a dense 8-second ABCD director prompt: three time windows (0-2 s Attract, 2-5 s Brand and Connect, 5-8 s Direct), an audio block with the music direction and a 12-16-word quoted English voiceover, and the aspect ratio 9:16 written inside the prompt text. It does not dump a storyboard.json and does not promise a stitched 30-second file. If the transfer tool is absent it delivers the storyboard plus the director prompt and explains the limitation in one sentence.
deterministic_checks: first tool call is transfer_to_agent with agent_name == 'videogen_agent' (or gen_video)
the transferred prompt mentions '9:16' and the three time windows ('0.0s', '2.0s', '5.0s', '8.0s')
the transferred prompt contains a quoted voiceover of 12-16 words
no storyboard.json text block appears before the transfer
the reply does not claim that a 30-second stitched MP4 was produced in chat
pass_criteria: all deterministic checks pass and the judge mean >= 1.5
